desc: a slag-bound golem: a hulking humanoid of stacked dark stone blocks with a glowing molten-orange core in its chest and glowing orange cracks between the blocks, thick block arms hanging at the sides, thick block legs, no neck
defect: every frame is the standing idle pose -- it has no walk at all
extra: A slow ponderous golem STOMP: each step lifts a whole block leg, the body rocks slightly onto the planted leg, arms swing a little; the molten core and cracks keep the SAME brightness in every frame.
